regions.note: Single semantic application header for brand/project, history, save state and Export. Per the browser feedback, workspace tabs and the compact workspace selector are removed; switching is owned by the shared Objects dock at every width, including onboarding.
BoardStudio brand and project selection rendered as real text, SVG icon and native project menu.
Existing history commands, accepted save status and Export navigation; no fabricated saved state.

Shared docked Objects shell and workspace navigation across Layout, PCB, Keymap, Keycaps, Case and Parts. Existing workspace trees retain their document selection, visibility and edit owners; onboarding remains a separate experience.

Reuse the same Objects navigation and dock styling on every editor workspace, including return to Layout and an explicit current-workspace state. Workspace-specific tree children still come from authoritative domain projections; navigation does not fabricate geometry selections.
Visible controlled snapping preferences at the foot of the left dock, including increment and geometry mode.
Dominant neutral canvas holding existing semantic CAD geometry, camera and selection interactions.

Compact opaque strip with direct Matrix, Row, Column, Key and Part scope choices plus Transform and Align popovers. Transform subfunctions are selection-aware in a small labeled popover; compact mode affects the strip only. Existing selection and tool callbacks, keyboard focus, dismissal and persisted density remain authoritative.

Batch 2: authoritative product geometry, selection-owned move, stagger, independent offset, splay/origin handles and editable measurements. Reuse existing typed fields and owned gestures; keep Graphite tokens and dock topology fixed.
Docked inspector with selected context, native numeric fields, persistent drafts and existing edit settlement.

Properties/Relations retain scoped native fields and drafts. Independently collapsible Position/orientation, row, column Position/rotation, Splay/origin, and key Geometry/Assembly sections use shared native BoardDisclosure, keeping children mounted; the pinned AccordionContent unmounts when closed and is unsuitable for these draft owners. Existing Key size disclosure and edit settlement remain intact.
Real camera controls, coordinates and existing grid/findings status; no generated measurements are copied.
